# Ocean - agentic email security candidate (2026-11-05)

**Canonical entity:** Ocean / Ocean Security, https://ocean.security/  
**Stage:** Research candidate; not benchmarked or editorially reviewed. **Primary category:** `email-security`.

**Vendor-published product:** investigates every email using agents for targeted phishing, BEC and financial fraud; also describes autonomous user-report triage and employee-facing email guidance. Marketing case quotations are selected customer statements, not independent benchmark evidence. [Official product](https://ocean.security/)

**Company signal:** company announced launch from stealth and $28M total funding on 2026-05-19. This is a vendor announcement, not validated ARR, market share or retention. [Launch note](https://ocean.security/resources/blog/ocean-launch-out-of-stealth)

**Buyer motion to validate:** investigation-first email protection with integrated SOC triage and employee support versus rule authoring, behavioral baseline or existing mail gateway.

**Unknown:** pricing metric, minimum term, production deployment and post-delivery action latency, OAuth scope, rollback, model/provider and data residency, control of autonomous decisions, MSSP multi-tenancy and reseller rights, independently measured efficacy.

**Pilot questions:** Show delivery-to-verdict-to-removal timestamps on representative BEC and phishing; evidence for each decision; analyst time on user reports; proof of safe release/rollback; contracted cost per mailbox; and explicit reseller support for a provider-operated SOC.

**Partner evidence (2026-11-06):** the [partner-program page](https://ocean.security/partner-program) advertises deal registration, co-selling and enablement (vendor marketing; publication date Unknown). This establishes a marketed channel motion, not documented MSSP tenancy, billing or resale contract terms. Product and launch sources also rechecked; no independent performance test.

**Source state:** official vendor site (publication date Unknown) and dated company launch, observed 2026-11-05; vendor-marketing and vendor-announcement only. **Review target:** 2026-12-05. **Owner/reviewer:** repository maintainer / unassigned. **Rights:** paraphrase and link.
